gbm_population_evidence.quote: Complement C5 mAb in the Treatment of Anti-GBM Disease
Positive circulating anti-GBM antibody, with proteinuria or hematuria or any clinical signs of kidney injuries.

candidate_evidence.quote: This study aims to the investigate the therapeutic effects and safety of C5 monoclonal antibody in the treatment of anti-GBM disease.

role_evidence.quote: C5 monoclonal treatment plus standard treatment
eculizumab 900mg iv. per week for 4 weeks, then 1200mg every two weeks for 8 weeks

coder_notes: 'GBM' here means anti-glomerular basement membrane disease (nephrology trial); excluded at S5. Eculizumab is the experimental agent of the arm but is tested for kidney disease, not as an antitumour agent, so has_eligible_candidate is false (no antitumour candidate). Unnamed 'standard treatment' (plasmapheresis/immunosuppressants) not listed because no agent is named.
